meta: Test where suggestions sit and measure the change in orders, with a clear result summary. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A/B testing for product recommendation placements
overview: Instead of guessing which placement works, we test it. We pick one or more recommendation spots, set up two versions, split your traffic and track clicks, add to carts and orders for each. We agree how long to run the test and how much data is enough before we read results. You receive a plain summary of what happened, how sure we are and what we suggest you do next.

faq: How long does a test take to run?
Building and checking takes a few days, and the test then runs in your store while visitors arrive. Small stores need more time. We tell you before we start how long a clear answer will likely take.
Not every store has enough visitors for a clean result. We check your traffic first and, if it is low, we suggest a simpler test or a longer window, rather than reading noise as a win.
Built in tools of your platform or recommendation app where possible, or a simple A and B app if needed. We tell you the cost of any app before use. Data stays in your accounts.
What if the test shows no difference?
That is a result too. It tells you the change is not worth keeping or paying for. We record it and suggest the next idea, so you learn something either way.
